About The Project

About the Project:

Nanhi Dulhan (The Little Bride) is a 30-page educational graphic novel
addressing the critical issue of child marriage in Pakistan, inspired by the
“monsoon brides” phenomenon following the 2022 floods in rural Punjab.

Taking visual inspiration from Sin City, the novel pairs a high-contrast
grayscale world with a symbolic three-stage color palette (Pink, Red, and
Maroon) to trace Huda’s stolen childhood from educational dreams to
forced underage motherhood.

Original Work: University Thesis Project
Created, Illustrated & Coded by: Abeerah Ramzan
Format: 30 Page Sequential Narrative | Urdu Edition
Tools: CSS/HTML 5
